name: Claymorphism
what_it_means: Claymorphism makes UI elements look like soft inflated clay: big rounded shapes, pastel colours, and a combination of outer drop shadows with inner highlights and inner shadows. It feels playful and approachable, often paired with 3D clay illustrations.
signature_moves: Very round corners (30px+) and pill buttons
Outer shadow + inner light + inner dark shadow
best_for: Kids & education, habit trackers, playful fintech, onboarding
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a mobile habit-tracker landing page in Claymorphism style. Pastel lavender background (#EFE7FF). All cards and buttons look like puffy clay: border-radius 32px+, an outer drop shadow (12px 12px 24px rgba(120,80,180,.3)) PLUS inner highlights (inset 6px 6px 12px rgba(255,255,255,.7)) and inner shade (inset -6px -6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.12)). Candy colours: pink #FF8FB1, sky #7CC6FE, butter #FFD36E. Add 3D clay-style blobs and a smiling mascot. Rounded chunky font (Fredoka / Baloo 2), deep purple text (#3B2A63). Buttons squish (scale 0.95) on press.
